message.reasoning: We need to determine correct answer. Premises: "Every sealed parcel is labeled. One parcel is not labeled. Must that parcel be unsealed?" From premise: all sealed parcels have labels. Contrapositive: If a parcel is not labeled, then it is not sealed (i.e., unsealed). This is logically valid because "Every sealed parcel is labeled" = ∀x (Sealed(x) → Labeled(x)). The contrapositive: ¬Labeled(x) → ¬Sealed(x). So any unlabeled parcel must be unsealed. Therefore the parcel not labeled must be unsealed. So answer is Yes. So output A.
